analysis:
This PR is an availability and recovery change to the local update CLI. It touches no crypto, attestation, authorization or data-exposure paths.

What changed:
- New helper ServiceDrain.relaunchDrainedProvider (ServiceDrain+Recovery.swift head 46-53) runs `defer { rearm(explicitConfig) }` around the relaunch closure.
- UpdateCommand.swift head 163-166 wraps stopDrainedProvider and LaunchAgent.restartAfterDrain in that helper.
- Previously (base 163-165), rearmWatchdog ran only on success. Now it also runs when stop or restart throws.

Ordering on the failure path (head 167-170): the watchdog is re-armed first. Only then does the catch release the session and call updater.cancelPendingCandidateAttempt. So for a short window the watchdog (installAndStart, or stop when disarming) may act while a candidate attempt is still pending.
- Relevant threat: T-043 / TB-003 (watchdog rollback authority is the same replaceable binary). This is a local-operator availability concern, not a consumer or provider trust escalation.
- The window could matter if WatchdogAgent.installAndStart immediately relaunches or rolls back based on pending candidate state.
- The WatchdogAgent and SelfUpdater sources were not supplied, so this interaction cannot be verified.

Rearm decision on failure: the arm/disarm choice comes from WatchdogAgent.rearmAction(autoRestartEnabled, isLoaded) (Recovery.swift 25-28). This keeps the operator's auto-restart choice; a disabled config yields disarm or nil. That limits concern about the PR resurrecting a provider an operator deliberately stopped.

Drain fence: the drain-timeout check in prepare (head 152) still throws before any relaunch, so it is unaffected.

Tests (ServiceDrainRearmTests.swift) only cover rearm being invoked exactly once on success and on failure. They do not cover ordering against cancelPendingCandidateAttempt.

No new network surface. No change to the A-003, A-008 or A-016 custody or authorization paths.

For the next pass: verify that WatchdogAgent.installAndStart and the SelfUpdater pending-candidate state cannot cause a quarantined or cancelled candidate to be launched, or rollback state to be corrupted, when re-arm precedes cancellation.
